![Region R partitioned into S, T, and U.](images/ed/ed0be2aca8d43d733e91f3a8feaaca0649957dcbd516a8218b1e7dea136170d8.png)

The finite region $R$ consists of $S$, $T$, and $U$, whose interiors do not overlap. Let

$$
f(x,y)=\begin{cases}e^{x+y},&(x,y)\in S\\y\cos x,&(x,y)\in T\\0,&(x,y)\in U.\end{cases}
$$

Values on shared boundaries do not affect the integrals. Which expression gives

$$
\iint_{R} f(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A
$$

by additivity?

error_profile: four distinct wrong assignments of the same formulas to regions
